name: Testimonial
description: Quotes from customers or readers with who said them: one large quote, or several as cards. Every quote is shown; rotating quotes are the slider's job.

layout.description: single: one large centred quote (the first item stands alone; more items stack). grid: cards, up to three per row. row: a horizontal strip that scrolls and snaps, no script. masonry: columns of quotes of different lengths.

quoteSize.description: The quote's text size. auto: the layout's own (body size in a grid, 2xl–3xl for a single quote). base, lg, xl: that size on every width.

frame.description: card: each quote in its box (a bordered, padded card in the grid; the surface colour in a muted section). plain: the quote and who said it straight on the section, across the column, with no box, as Elementor's testimonial widget draws them.

avatarSize.description: The portrait's size: small, medium or large.

avatarPlace.description: start: the portrait beside the name. top: above the quote.

quoteMark.description: marks: quotation marks around the text. glyph: one large decorative mark above. none: no marks.

items.label: Testimonials

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: What the person said, in their words.

avatarAlt.label: Photo description
avatarAlt.description: Who the photo shows; usually their name.

rating.label: Rating
rating.description: Stars out of 5; leave empty for none.

logo.label: Company logo
logo.description: The company's logo beside the name.

logoAlt.label: Company name
logoAlt.description: The company the logo stands for.

items.description: The quotes (Elementor testimonial content/name/job/image, Divi testimonial body/author/job_title/portrait_url).

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour laid over the image, with its alpha.

size.description: How the image fills the section.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

ratingLabel.description: The stars' spoken text; `{rating}` stands for the number ("{rating} out of 5 stars").

label.description: The scrolling row's name for assistive technology when there is no heading ("Testimonials").

a11y: Each quote is a <figure> whose <figcaption> names the speaker; the text is in a <blockquote>. Avatars are decorative when their alt is empty. The section is labelled by its heading when it has one. Stars are one image named by the real rating ("4.8 out of 5 stars"); the row layout is a focusable named region.
